source_review: Actual foundation region helpers, Default vertex Fresnel 0.4/0.6, packed normal decoding, custom light(), native specular compensation and actual fake_specular block retained. Baked GI replaces panorama only because every base pixel source samples the atlas.
Source Luminescence differs from Common: baked GI uses GI0Scale RGB without g_Ambient; g_Ambient instead multiplies emission. Preserve atlas RGB square, saturation and ambient-shadow mixing.

Source Luminescence uses gloss=1 when no power map is sampled, verified from its literal 500/5 operands and PowerGlossLevel.yz multiply. This source-defined exception does not change ordinary Generations material behavior. Mapped gloss uses the established P=clamp(gloss*y*500,1,1024), gain=gloss*z*5.

Regular Luminescence emission is sampled RGB or g_Emission RGB, multiplied by ambient, playable fade and final material COLOR. Source LuminescenceV uses vertex COLOR RGB as emission instead of tinting the lit material, with optional RGB emission mask. Vertex alpha blends the two diffuse and gloss textures only in the dual-layer variants; it does not multiply output alpha for V variants.

Original alpha combines sampled or blended diffuse alpha, material alpha, opacity, force alpha and regular-variant vertex alpha. Material RGB factors precede each contribution square. Same-fragment GI/emission/environment additions retain explicit pairwise interaction terms; camera highlight remains an independent foundation contribution.

Environment uses actual source sphere/cube sampler projection, power mask and original shadow/Fresnel factors. The shared cross-atlas adapter represents cube sources as sampler2D without changing the reflection vector.
Godot light attenuation and native shadow integration remain established renderer boundaries; original scattering and final framebuffer cap are not asserted as reproduced.

Measured stock Godot native specular transfer also applies to Generations: divide only SPECULAR_LIGHT input RGB by PI and the residual1.5696 from the retained gain100/default BRDF. Original material/gloss math and foundation fake_specular are unchanged; diffuse/rim keep their established integration.

Original camera range/cone attenuation multiplies each actual foundation fake_specular contribution before its square, alongside the source camera RGB input. Mode <=0 bypasses attenuation, mode >0 enables the Range.zw distance ramp, mode >1 also enables the Attribute.yz smoothstep cone raised to Attribute.w. Godot fragment VERTEX supplies camera-space distance and forward cosine without HE1 matrix uniforms. Bind range distances in model export units; bind Attribute as raw Plane. Default mode 0 preserves existing callers until original scene camera values are supplied. This does not implement the separate source camera diffuse contribution.

Regular Luminescence emission is sampled RGB or g_Emission RGB, multiplied by ambient, playable fade and final material COLOR. Source LuminescenceV uses vertex COLOR RGB as emission instead of tinting the lit material, with optional RGB emission mask. Original alpha combines sampled or blended diffuse alpha, material alpha, opacity, force alpha and regular-variant vertex alpha. Material RGB factors precede each contribution square. Same-fragment GI/emission/environment additions retain explicit pairwise interaction terms; camera highlight remains an independent foundation contribution.

Environment uses actual source sphere/cube sampler projection, power mask and original shadow/Fresnel factors. The shared cross-atlas adapter represents cube sources as sampler2D without changing the reflection vector.

Linked original vertex stages negate the authored BINORMAL before interpolation. Original camera range/cone attenuation multiplies each actual foundation fake_specular contribution before its square, alongside the source camera RGB input. source_review: Actual foundation region helpers, Default vertex Fresnel 0.4/0.6, packed normal decoding, custom light(), native specular compensation and actual fake_specular block retained. Baked GI replaces panorama only because every base pixel source samples the atlas.
Source Luminescence differs from Common: baked GI uses GI0Scale RGB without g_Ambient; g_Ambient instead multiplies emission. Preserve atlas RGB square, saturation and ambient-shadow mixing.

Source Luminescence uses gloss=1 when no power map is sampled, verified from its literal 500/5 operands and PowerGlossLevel.yz multiply. This source-defined exception does not change ordinary Generations material behavior. Mapped gloss uses the established P=clamp(gloss*y*500,1,1024), gain=gloss*z*5.

Regular Luminescence emission is sampled RGB or g_Emission RGB, multiplied by ambient, playable fade and final material COLOR. Source LuminescenceV uses vertex COLOR RGB as emission instead of tinting the lit material, with optional RGB emission mask. Vertex alpha blends the two diffuse and gloss textures only in the dual-layer variants; it does not multiply output alpha for V variants.

Original alpha combines sampled or blended diffuse alpha, material alpha, opacity, force alpha and regular-variant vertex alpha. Material RGB factors precede each contribution square. Same-fragment GI/emission/environment additions retain explicit pairwise interaction terms; camera highlight remains an independent foundation contribution.

Environment uses actual source sphere/cube sampler projection, power mask and original shadow/Fresnel factors. The shared cross-atlas adapter represents cube sources as sampler2D without changing the reflection vector.
Godot light attenuation and native shadow integration remain established renderer boundaries; original scattering and final framebuffer cap are not asserted as reproduced.

Linked original vertex stages negate the authored BINORMAL before interpolation. Apply BINORMAL = -BINORMAL once before foundation basis caching; keep the original normal decoder and texture unchanged. Face-local analytic derivatives select original cube mip levels; per-level half-texel bounds avoid neighboring atlas cells. environment_max_lod is sampler metadata, defaulting safely to base-only when no mip chain is supplied.

Measured stock Godot native specular transfer also applies to Generations: divide only SPECULAR_LIGHT input RGB by PI and the residual1.5696 from the retained gain100/default BRDF. Original material/gloss math and foundation fake_specular are unchanged; diffuse/rim keep their established integration.

Original camera range/cone attenuation multiplies each actual foundation fake_specular contribution before its square, alongside the source camera RGB input. Mode <=0 bypasses attenuation, mode >0 enables the Range.zw distance ramp, mode >1 also enables the Attribute.yz smoothstep cone raised to Attribute.w. Godot fragment VERTEX supplies camera-space distance and forward cosine without HE1 matrix uniforms. Bind range distances in model export units; bind Attribute as raw Plane. Default mode 0 preserves existing callers until original scene camera values are supplied. This does not implement the separate source camera diffuse contribution.

source_review: Actual foundation region helpers, Default vertex Fresnel 0.4/0.6, packed normal decoding, custom light(), native specular compensation and actual fake_specular block retained. Baked GI replaces panorama only because every base pixel source samples the atlas.
Source Luminescence differs from Common: baked GI uses GI0Scale RGB without g_Ambient; g_Ambient instead multiplies emission. Preserve atlas RGB square, saturation and ambient-shadow mixing.

Source Luminescence uses gloss=1 when no power map is sampled, verified from its literal 500/5 operands and PowerGlossLevel.yz multiply. This source-defined exception does not change ordinary Generations material behavior. Mapped gloss uses the established P=clamp(gloss*y*500,1,1024), gain=gloss*z*5.

Regular Luminescence emission is sampled RGB or g_Emission RGB, multiplied by ambient, playable fade and final material COLOR. Source LuminescenceV uses vertex COLOR RGB as emission instead of tinting the lit material, with optional RGB emission mask. Vertex alpha blends the two diffuse and gloss textures only in the dual-layer variants; it does not multiply output alpha for V variants.

Original alpha combines sampled or blended diffuse alpha, material alpha, opacity, force alpha and regular-variant vertex alpha. Material RGB factors precede each contribution square. Same-fragment GI/emission/environment additions retain explicit pairwise interaction terms; camera highlight remains an independent foundation contribution.

Environment uses actual source sphere/cube sampler projection, power mask and original shadow/Fresnel factors. The shared cross-atlas adapter represents cube sources as sampler2D without changing the reflection vector.
Godot light attenuation and native shadow integration remain established renderer boundaries; original scattering and final framebuffer cap are not asserted as reproduced.

Linked original vertex stages negate the authored BINORMAL before interpolation. Apply BINORMAL = -BINORMAL once before foundation basis caching; keep the original normal decoder and texture unchanged. Stage evidence: [{'source': 'he1shaders/gens hlsl/Default_@nv@.wvu.hlsl', 'negated_input': 'v8', 'lines': [136, 137, 138, 143, 144]}, {'source': 'he1shaders/gens hlsl/Default_@nv@p.wvu.hlsl', 'negated_input': 'v12', 'lines': [147, 148, 149, 157, 158]}]

Measured stock Godot native specular transfer also applies to Generations: divide only SPECULAR_LIGHT input RGB by PI and the residual1.5696 from the retained gain100/default BRDF. Original material/gloss math and foundation fake_specular are unchanged; diffuse/rim keep their established integration.

Original camera range/cone attenuation multiplies each actual foundation fake_specular contribution before its square, alongside the source camera RGB input. Mode <=0 bypasses attenuation, mode >0 enables the Range.zw distance ramp, mode >1 also enables the Attribute.yz smoothstep cone raised to Attribute.w. Godot fragment VERTEX supplies camera-space distance and forward cosine without HE1 matrix uniforms. Bind range distances in model export units; bind Attribute as raw Plane. Default mode 0 preserves existing callers until original scene camera values are supplied. This does not implement the separate source camera diffuse contribution.

Original opacity multiplies texture/material/vertex alpha. No emission source or unused emission uniforms retained.
This source has no environment sampler; no environment interface is added.
Original per-light shadow-map selection remains a renderer boundary; preserve established PRR region and native-light integration rather than introducing unbound HE1 constants.
No independent specular RGB map is sampled.

Godot 3.1 uploads scene light RGB times energy times PI. Convert native specular light units once and divide the measured downstream residual: default roughness 1, metallic 0 and specular 0.5 produce Lazarov env=(0.4524,-0.0024), F0=0.04, hence BRDF=0.015696 and retained gain 100 leaves 1.5696. Correct this renderer residual separately from HE1 material math and fake_specular. Foundation diffuse/rim inputs and final specular gain 100 remain unchanged. Material-default writes fail closed pending a revised transfer analysis.

The source camera RGB multiplier and the actual foundation camera constant multiply the individual fake_specular contribution before its square. Preserve this ordering with the unchanged Unleashed default 0.2. The rejected post-square adapter changed I^2 into I and made 0.2 five times stronger in linear output. Source gloss, lobe mixture and final native-light 100 remain unchanged; Generations retains its existing 0.8 path.

Bind original material diffuse RGB as raw Plane values and multiply the sampled texture before the foundation contribution square. Both linear-target and final displayed response are tested; moving tint after the square would apply an unintended output-gamma curve to the material parameter.

Default mode 0 preserves existing callers until original scene camera values are supplied. This does not implement the separate source camera diffuse contribution.

Godot 3.1 uploads scene light RGB times energy times PI. Convert native specular light units once and divide the measured downstream residual: default roughness 1, metallic 0 and specular 0.5 produce Lazarov env=(0.4524,-0.0024), F0=0.04, hence BRDF=0.015696 and retained gain 100 leaves 1.5696. Correct this renderer residual separately from HE1 material math and fake_specular. Foundation diffuse/rim inputs and final specular gain 100 remain unchanged. Material-default writes fail closed pending a revised transfer analysis.

The source camera RGB multiplier and the actual foundation camera constant multiply the individual fake_specular contribution before its square. Preserve this ordering with the unchanged Unleashed default 0.2. The rejected post-square adapter changed I^2 into I and made 0.2 five times stronger in linear output. Source gloss, lobe mixture and final native-light 100 remain unchanged; Generations retains its existing 0.8 path.

Bind original material diffuse RGB as raw Plane values and multiply the sampled texture before the foundation contribution square. Both linear-target and final displayed response are tested; moving tint after the square would apply an unintended output-gamma curve to the material parameter.

Original camera range/cone attenuation multiplies each actual foundation fake_specular contribution before its square, alongside the source camera RGB input. Mode <=0 bypasses attenuation, mode >0 enables the Range.zw distance ramp, mode >1 also enables the Attribute.yz smoothstep cone raised to Attribute.w. Godot fragment VERTEX supplies camera-space distance and forward cosine without HE1 matrix uniforms. Bind range distances in model export units; bind Attribute as raw Plane. Default mode 0 preserves existing callers until original scene camera values are supplied. This does not implement the separate source camera diffuse contribution.

Godot 3.1 uploads scene light RGB times energy times PI. Convert native specular light units once and divide the measured downstream residual: default roughness 1, metallic 0 and specular 0.5 produce Lazarov env=(0.4524,-0.0024), F0=0.04, hence BRDF=0.015696 and retained gain 100 leaves 1.5696. Correct this renderer residual separately from HE1 material math and fake_specular. Foundation diffuse/rim inputs and final specular gain 100 remain unchanged. Material-default writes fail closed pending a revised transfer analysis.

The source camera RGB multiplier and the actual foundation camera constant multiply the individual fake_specular contribution before its square. Preserve this ordering with the unchanged Unleashed default 0.2. The rejected post-square adapter changed I^2 into I and made 0.2 five times stronger in linear output. Source gloss, lobe mixture and final native-light 100 remain unchanged; Generations retains its existing 0.8 path.

Bind original material diffuse RGB as raw Plane values and multiply the sampled texture before the foundation contribution square. Both linear-target and final displayed response are tested; moving tint after the square would apply an unintended output-gamma curve to the material parameter.

Original camera range/cone attenuation multiplies each actual foundation fake_specular contribution before its square, alongside the source camera RGB input. Mode <=0 bypasses attenuation, mode >0 enables the Range.zw distance ramp, mode >1 also enables the Attribute.yz smoothstep cone raised to Attribute.w. Godot fragment VERTEX supplies camera-space distance and forward cosine without HE1 matrix uniforms. Bind range distances in model export units; bind Attribute as raw Plane. Default mode 0 preserves existing callers until original scene camera values are supplied. This does not implement the separate source camera diffuse contribution.

Linked original vertex stages negate the authored BINORMAL before interpolation. Godot 3.1 uploads scene light RGB times energy times PI. Convert native specular light units once and divide the measured downstream residual: default roughness 1, metallic 0 and specular 0.5 produce Lazarov env=(0.4524,-0.0024), F0=0.04, hence BRDF=0.015696 and retained gain 100 leaves 1.5696. Correct this renderer residual separately from HE1 material math and fake_specular. Foundation diffuse/rim inputs and final specular gain 100 remain unchanged. Material-default writes fail closed pending a revised transfer analysis.

The source camera RGB multiplier and the actual foundation camera constant multiply the individual fake_specular contribution before its square. Preserve this ordering with the unchanged Unleashed default 0.2. The rejected post-square adapter changed I^2 into I and made 0.2 five times stronger in linear output. Source gloss, lobe mixture and final native-light 100 remain unchanged; Generations retains its existing 0.8 path.

Bind original material diffuse RGB as raw Plane values and multiply the sampled texture before the foundation contribution square. Both linear-target and final displayed response are tested; moving tint after the square would apply an unintended output-gamma curve to the material parameter.

Original camera range/cone attenuation multiplies each actual foundation fake_specular contribution before its square, alongside the source camera RGB input. Mode <=0 bypasses attenuation, mode >0 enables the Range.zw distance ramp, mode >1 also enables the Attribute.yz smoothstep cone raised to Attribute.w. Godot fragment VERTEX supplies camera-space distance and forward cosine without HE1 matrix uniforms. Bind range distances in model export units; bind Attribute as raw Plane. Default mode 0 preserves existing callers until original scene camera values are supplied. This does not implement the separate source camera diffuse contribution.

Original fragment radiance terms add before output transfer. Retain the actual foundation individual squares and add the exact pairwise interaction terms between equally weighted fragment contributions: ['2.0 * light_field * environment.rgb']. This localized source-backed composition matches the user-identified 15:03 fragment checkpoint. Native light(), fake_specular transfer, per-light compensation, panorama/region helpers and vertex processing are unchanged. No native accumulator recovery or final-output compatibility square is introduced.

Default source uses GI atlas encoded RGB squared before saturation and ambient scaling. Material diffuse tint multiplies direct diffuse only; ambient uses the sampled diffuse and optional vertex color without material tint.

Specular P=clamp(power.r*exp2(material.y*10+2),1,512), gain=P/8; absent power map uses 1. Blinn angular response is gated by saturate(NdotL) and the linked SSS fifth-power Fresnel endpoints 0.0361540653/0.963845909.

Vertex COLOR modulates diffuse RGB/alpha only.
Original native shadow map and GI global/local light selection remain renderer integration boundaries; PRR region shadow and native attenuation retain the established foundation behavior.

Godot 3.1 uploads scene light RGB times energy times PI. Convert native specular light units once and divide the measured downstream residual: default roughness 1, metallic 0 and specular 0.5 produce Lazarov env=(0.4524,-0.0024), F0=0.04, hence BRDF=0.015696 and retained gain 100 leaves 1.5696. Correct this renderer residual separately from HE1 material math and fake_specular. Foundation diffuse/rim inputs and final specular gain 100 remain unchanged. Material-default writes fail closed pending a revised transfer analysis.

The source camera RGB multiplier and the actual foundation camera constant multiply the individual fake_specular contribution before its square. Preserve this ordering with the unchanged Unleashed default 0.2. The rejected post-square adapter changed I^2 into I and made 0.2 five times stronger in linear output. Source gloss, lobe mixture and final native-light 100 remain unchanged; Generations retains its existing 0.8 path.

Bind original material diffuse RGB as raw Plane values and multiply the sampled texture before the foundation contribution square. Both linear-target and final displayed response are tested; moving tint after the square would apply an unintended output-gamma curve to the material parameter.

Original camera range/cone attenuation multiplies each actual foundation fake_specular contribution before its square, alongside the source camera RGB input. Mode <=0 bypasses attenuation, mode >0 enables the Range.zw distance ramp, mode >1 also enables the Attribute.yz smoothstep cone raised to Attribute.w. Godot fragment VERTEX supplies camera-space distance and forward cosine without HE1 matrix uniforms. Bind range distances in model export units; bind Attribute as raw Plane. Default mode 0 preserves existing callers until original scene camera values are supplied. This does not implement the separate source camera diffuse contribution.

source_review: Reflection direction retains its original per-pixel world-space projection.
Xbox and Windows agree on normal-map use and packed dual paraboloid reflection fetch.
Enamel uses specular A for gloss and RGB for direct and reflected tint.
Source uses an exponent-dependent gain of 1/8 and a front-facing specular cosine gate.
Environment attenuation is 0.3 + 0.7 times region shadow, not a second view-angle Fresnel. The paired vertex supplies Fresnel.

Retains the actual foundation view-highlight block with source exponent, gain, tint and the material front gate before the contribution square. Renderer integration supplies the independent camera intensity. It supplies the foundation camera response; original HE1 camera range/cone settings are not reproduced.

Linked original vertex stages negate the authored BINORMAL before interpolation. Apply BINORMAL = -BINORMAL once before foundation basis caching; keep the original normal decoder and texture unchanged. Stage evidence: [{'source': 'he1shaders/unleashed hlsl/CharactorDefault_@bn@.wvu.hlsl', 'negated_input': 'v7', 'lines': [129, 131, 132, 137, 142]}, {'source': 'he1shaders/unleashed hlsl/CharactorDefault_@bn@p.wvu.hlsl', 'negated_input': 'v11', 'lines': [139, 140, 141, 150, 152]}]

Original paired vertex Fresnel is evaluated by the retained compute_fresnel helper using source mrgFresnelParam endpoints. vertex_fresnel caches its interpolated result; no duplicate inline equation or unused helper remains.

Godot 3.1 uploads scene light RGB times energy times PI. Convert native specular light units once and divide the measured downstream residual: default roughness 1, metallic 0 and specular 0.5 produce Lazarov env=(0.4524,-0.0024), F0=0.04, hence BRDF=0.015696 and retained gain 100 leaves 1.5696. Correct this renderer residual separately from HE1 material math and fake_specular. Foundation diffuse/rim inputs and final specular gain 100 remain unchanged. Material-default writes fail closed pending a revised transfer analysis.

The source camera RGB multiplier and the actual foundation camera constant multiply the individual fake_specular contribution before its square. Preserve this ordering with the unchanged Unleashed default 0.2. The rejected post-square adapter changed I^2 into I and made 0.2 five times stronger in linear output. Source gloss, lobe mixture and final native-light 100 remain unchanged; Generations retains its existing 0.8 path.

Bind original material diffuse RGB as raw Plane values and multiply the sampled texture before the foundation contribution square. Both linear-target and final displayed response are tested; moving tint after the square would apply an unintended output-gamma curve to the material parameter.

Original camera range/cone attenuation multiplies each actual foundation fake_specular contribution before its square, alongside the source camera RGB input. Mode <=0 bypasses attenuation, mode >0 enables the Range.zw distance ramp, mode >1 also enables the Attribute.yz smoothstep cone raised to Attribute.w. Godot fragment VERTEX supplies camera-space distance and forward cosine without HE1 matrix uniforms. Bind range distances in model export units; bind Attribute as raw Plane. Default mode 0 preserves existing callers until original scene camera values are supplied. This does not implement the separate source camera diffuse contribution.

Original fragment radiance terms add before output transfer. Retain the actual foundation individual squares and add the exact pairwise interaction terms between equally weighted fragment contributions: ['2.0 * light_field * environment.rgb']. This localized source-backed composition matches the user-identified 15:03 fragment checkpoint. Native light(), fake_specular transfer, per-light compensation, panorama/region helpers and vertex processing are unchanged. No native accumulator recovery or final-output compatibility square is introduced.

Godot 3.1 uploads scene light RGB times energy times PI. Correct this renderer residual separately from HE1 material math and fake_specular. Foundation diffuse/rim inputs and final specular gain 100 remain unchanged. Material-default writes fail closed pending a revised transfer analysis.

The source camera RGB multiplier and the actual foundation camera constant multiply the individual fake_specular contribution before its square. Preserve this ordering with the unchanged Unleashed default 0.2. The rejected post-square adapter changed I^2 into I and made 0.2 five times stronger in linear output. Source gloss, lobe mixture and final native-light 100 remain unchanged; Generations retains its existing 0.8 path.

Bind original material diffuse RGB as raw Plane values and multiply the sampled texture before the foundation contribution square. Both linear-target and final displayed response are tested; moving tint after the square would apply an unintended output-gamma curve to the material parameter.

Original camera range/cone attenuation multiplies each actual foundation fake_specular contribution before its square, alongside the source camera RGB input. Mode <=0 bypasses attenuation, mode >0 enables the Range.zw distance ramp, mode >1 also enables the Attribute.yz smoothstep cone raised to Attribute.w. Godot fragment VERTEX supplies camera-space distance and forward cosine without HE1 matrix uniforms. Bind range distances in model export units; bind Attribute as raw Plane. Default mode 0 preserves existing callers until original scene camera values are supplied. This does not implement the separate source camera diffuse contribution.

Original fragment radiance terms add before output transfer. Retain the actual foundation individual squares and add the exact pairwise interaction terms between equally weighted fragment contributions: ['2.0 * eye_highlight * reflection * vColor.rgb', '2.0 * eye_highlight * ambient * vColor.rgb', '2.0 * reflection * ambient * vColor.rgb']. This localized source-backed composition matches the user-identified 15:03 fragment checkpoint. Native light(), fake_specular transfer, per-light compensation, panorama/region helpers and vertex processing are unchanged. No native accumulator recovery or final-output compatibility square is introduced.
